scripts.dev: concurrently -n daemon,ui -c red,blue "cargo run -p dyd-daemon" "npm run dev -w dyd-ui"
scripts.build: cargo build -p dyd-daemon && npm run build -w dyd-ui
scripts.lint: cargo clippy -- -D warnings && npm run lint -w dyd-ui
scripts.format: cargo fmt && npm run format -w dyd-ui
scripts.format:check: cargo fmt --check && npm run format:check -w dyd-ui
scripts.clean: cargo clean && npm run clean -w dyd-ui
